resources.string: The X11 test screen uses the same virtual screen. Stop the game to open it.
No arm64-v8a (%1$s): FEX runs on ARM64 only.
Missing %1$s: this build of FEX needs ARMv8.2 (Snapdragon 845 or newer).
Adreno (unknown model: “%1$s”). Run Advanced › Recon for details.
GPU %1$s: no Turnip (it works on Adreno/Snapdragon only). Graphics run on the processor (lavapipe): Steam and light 2D games work, big 3D games will be very slow.
Adreno %1$s: supported by Turnip; not tested with fexdroid yet.
Adreno %1$s: Turnip supports the 6xx, 7xx and 8xx series only.
%1$s (FEX recommends 5.15+; 5.4 is verified on a Realme GT)
%1$s: older than 5.4, not tested. FEX may have problems (it recommends 5.15+).
%1$d GB: little for Steam and games; only small programs work.
%1$d GB: Dota 2 holds 5 to 6 GB here, and 3 to 4 GB of video memory. In long sessions Android can run out of memory and close the game: close other apps, and restart the app between matches.
%1$d KB: FEX works with 4 KB pages only.

Android may stop Steam (limit %1$d). Switch it off in Developer options › “Disable child process restrictions”, or from a PC: adb shell device_config put activity_manager max_phantom_processes 2147483647
%1$d GB: the Linux environment and Steam need about 5 GB, games need tens of GB.
The “modern” variant (targetSdk %1$d) cannot run programs from the app\'s data. Install the “legacy” variant.
The connection was lost. Try again.
The connection was lost during the download. Try again.
No internet connection. Switch on Wi-Fi or mobile data and try again.
The phone is out of space: about 700 MB must be free.
The virtual screen (Xvfb) did not start.
Dota 2 is not installed on the phone. Install it from Steam.
The Linux environment could not be installed.
FEX\'s defaults, with x87 on 64 bits as in FEX\'s configuration for Steam. Recommended.
Full x86 memory ordering, for vectors and memcpy too. The slowest; for games that crash.
No emulation of x86 memory ordering anywhere. Much faster, but many games crash or hang: Dota 2 hangs while loading.
Without the Steam client: no online play, for testing only
Dota 2 is not installed: install it from Steam
Downloaded when Steam starts for the first time
The first start downloads the Steam client from Valve
Prepared by the app once Steam has downloaded its runtime
How do I install Steam and games?
Installs itself at the first start (1–2 minutes)
Sign in with your password or with the QR code, from the Steam app on another phone
Not installed: install it from Steam
It may work; things to know: %1$d
The Linux environment cannot run on this phone
Debian packages (amd64 + i386), no files from Valve. About 250 MB to download, 600 MB installed.
Steam\'s libraries are missing: see Status, above
Linux PC games, running on the phone itself
Touch to go back to the game
This APK has no Linux payload (developers: run scripts/build-payload.sh).
The Linux environment was built for %1$s, but the app uses %2$s. Install the “legacy” variant, as the phone\'s main user.
The program closed. If you did not close it yourself, press “Send the log”.
At the sides of the picture, for playing by touch
%1$s is loading. The first start can take a few minutes. Menu: the button on the right.
The phone is running out of memory. The game may slow down a lot or close. After this match, stop the game and start it again.
Progress that was not saved is lost.
The program stopped with code %1$d. Press “Send the log”.
A game is running: the new values are used after it is started again.
The full-screen interface, for touch and controllers. Heavier than the desktop one. The first sign-in is done in the desktop interface.
Experimental. Translated x86 code is kept and used again, so later starts are faster. With FEX-2609 some programs crash (Steam\'s setup is one), so it is off by default.
The game\'s video settings at their cheapest values: no shadows, few effects, smaller textures. Applied when Steam starts, once the game has been started one time. Off: your own settings come back.
The virtual screen is as wide as the phone\'s screen shape asks, with no black bars. Off: 16:9.
How often the app looks for a new picture from the game. Only new pictures are copied to the screen.
Games ask the graphics processor for its highest frequency while they draw. More frames, a warmer phone. Only on phones with an Adreno.
Included in the app; installs itself at the first start.
Steam downloads it from Valve when it starts for the first time (about 2 GB, a few minutes). Then sign in.
In Steam: Store › Dota 2 › Play Game › Install. About 70 GB; the download goes on with the app in the background.

Everything is installed on the phone, no PC needed. Nothing from Valve is in this app: Steam and the games are downloaded from Valve, with your own account. Use Wi-Fi and keep the phone on its charger.
Keys at the left and right of the picture, which gets narrower to make room for them. The game\'s menu can show and hide them too.
Back to the keys for Dota 2

Names separated by spaces: letters, digits, F1 to F12, Esc, Tab, Space, Enter, Back, Del, Up, Down, Left, Right. Shift, Ctrl and Alt stay pressed until you tap them again. Mouse chooses the button a tap presses: left or right; a tap with two fingers presses the other one. Swipe chooses what a swipe does: turns the wheel, or moves the camera (a drag with the middle button).
Distance between the picture and the edges of the screen. Rounded corners and the camera cover what a game draws there, and touches at the edge are often lost.
Used from the next start of the game.
Size of the virtual screen. Smaller is faster. Used from the next start.
Fast memory access for Dota 2 and CS2 (experimental)
The game\'s own libraries run without the emulation of x86 memory ordering, the most expensive part of the translation. More frames. If the game hangs or closes, switch this off and send the log.
The fastest core for the main thread
The busiest thread of the game gets the phone\'s fastest core for itself; the game\'s other threads run on the other big cores, Steam and the rest on the small ones.

Games are told of 40% of the phone\'s memory as video memory (at least 4 GB) instead of 75%, so they keep fewer textures loaded. The gain is small: Dota 2 holds 0.2 to 0.3 GB less. A game that needs more than that ends with “out of video memory”.
The picture stays further from the left and right edges. On realme, OPPO and OnePlus the phone\'s game bar covers the left edge: a game\'s buttons under it cannot be touched.
The main button on Home becomes “Start Dota 2 (without Steam)”.
Without the Steam client the game starts for testing only: no sign-in, no online matches, no updates. To play, use Steam.
Confirm the installation if Android asks. The app closes while it is installed: open it again afterwards.
The downloaded file is not the published one. Try again.
The installed version is signed with another key than the new one, so Android cannot replace it. Once only: uninstall the app and install it again from GitHub. (%1$s)
